tpcdi-etl:duckdb:customer_mgmt: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE CustomerMgmtRaw AS WITH actions AS (SELECT UNNEST(XML_EXTRACT_ELEMENTS(xml, '//*[local-name()=''Action'']')) AS node FROM READ_XML_OBJECTS($customer_mgmt_path, maximum_file_size => 2000000000)), fields AS (SELECT XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '/*/@ActionType')[1] AS actiontype, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '/*/@ActionTS')[1] AS actionts, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//Customer/@C_ID')[1] AS customerid, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//Customer/@C_TAX_ID')[1] AS taxid, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//Customer/@C_GNDR')[1] AS gender, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//Customer/@C_TIER')[1] AS tier, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//Customer/@C_DOB')[1] AS dob, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//Account/@CA_ID')[1] AS accountid, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//Account/@CA_TAX_ST')[1] AS taxstatus, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//Account/CA_B_ID')[1] AS brokerid, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//Account/CA_NAME')[1] AS accountdesc, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//Name/C_L_NAME')[1] AS lastname, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//Name/C_F_NAME')[1] AS firstname, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//Name/C_M_NAME')[1] AS middleinitial, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//Address/C_ADLINE1')[1] AS addressline1, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//Address/C_ADLINE2')[1] AS addressline2, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//Address/C_ZIPCODE')[1] AS postalcode, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//Address/C_CITY')[1] AS city, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//Address/C_STATE_PROV')[1] AS stateprov, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//Address/C_CTRY')[1] AS country, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//C_PHONE_1/C_CTRY_CODE')[1] AS phone1_ctry, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//C_PHONE_1/C_AREA_CODE')[1] AS phone1_area, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//C_PHONE_1/C_LOCAL')[1] AS phone1_local, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//C_PHONE_1/C_EXT')[1] AS phone1_ext, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//C_PHONE_2/C_CTRY_CODE')[1] AS phone2_ctry, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//C_PHONE_2/C_AREA_CODE')[1] AS phone2_area, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//C_PHONE_2/C_LOCAL')[1] AS phone2_local, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//C_PHONE_2/C_EXT')[1] AS phone2_ext, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//C_PHONE_3/C_CTRY_CODE')[1] AS phone3_ctry, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//C_PHONE_3/C_AREA_CODE')[1] AS phone3_area, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//C_PHONE_3/C_LOCAL')[1] AS phone3_local, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//C_PHONE_3/C_EXT')[1] AS phone3_ext, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//ContactInfo/C_PRIM_EMAIL')[1] AS email1, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//ContactInfo/C_ALT_EMAIL')[1] AS email2, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//TaxInfo/C_LCL_TX_ID')[1] AS lcl_tx_id, XML_EXTRACT_TEXT(node, '//TaxInfo/C_NAT_TX_ID')[1] AS nat_tx_id FROM actions) SELECT CAST(NULLIF(customerid, '') AS BIGINT) AS customerid, CAST(NULLIF(accountid, '') AS BIGINT) AS accountid, CAST(NULLIF(brokerid, '') AS BIGINT) AS brokerid, NULLIF(taxid, '') AS taxid, NULLIF(accountdesc, '') AS accountdesc, CAST(NULLIF(taxstatus, '') AS SMALLINT) AS taxstatus, NULLIF(lastname, '') AS lastname, NULLIF(firstname, '') AS firstname, NULLIF(middleinitial, '') AS middleinitial, NULLIF(gender, '') AS gender, CAST(NULLIF(tier, '') AS SMALLINT) AS tier, CAST(NULLIF(dob, '') AS DATE) AS dob, NULLIF(addressline1, '') AS addressline1, NULLIF(addressline2, '') AS addressline2, NULLIF(postalcode, '') AS postalcode, NULLIF(city, '') AS city, NULLIF(stateprov, '') AS stateprov, NULLIF(country, '') AS country, CASE WHEN NOT NULLIF(phone1_local, '') IS NULL THEN CONCAT(CASE WHEN NOT NULLIF(phone1_ctry, '') IS NULL AND NOT NULLIF(phone1_area, '') IS NULL THEN '+' || phone1_ctry || ' ' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN NOT NULLIF(phone1_area, '') IS NULL THEN '(' || phone1_area || ') ' ELSE '' END, phone1_local, COALESCE(phone1_ext, '')) END AS phone1, CASE WHEN NOT NULLIF(phone2_local, '') IS NULL THEN CONCAT(CASE WHEN NOT NULLIF(phone2_ctry, '') IS NULL AND NOT NULLIF(phone2_area, '') IS NULL THEN '+' || phone2_ctry || ' ' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN NOT NULLIF(phone2_area, '') IS NULL THEN '(' || phone2_area || ') ' ELSE '' END, phone2_local, COALESCE(phone2_ext, '')) END AS phone2, CASE WHEN NOT NULLIF(phone3_local, '') IS NULL THEN CONCAT(CASE WHEN NOT NULLIF(phone3_ctry, '') IS NULL AND NOT NULLIF(phone3_area, '') IS NULL THEN '+' || phone3_ctry || ' ' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN NOT NULLIF(phone3_area, '') IS NULL THEN '(' || phone3_area || ') ' ELSE '' END, phone3_local, COALESCE(phone3_ext, '')) END AS phone3, NULLIF(email1, '') AS email1, NULLIF(email2, '') AS email2, NULLIF(lcl_tx_id, '') AS lcl_tx_id, NULLIF(nat_tx_id, '') AS nat_tx_id, CAST(NULLIF(actionts, '') AS TIMESTAMP) AS update_ts, actiontype FROM fields
tpcdi-etl:duckdb:prospect: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE ProspectRaw AS WITH prospect AS (SELECT * EXCLUDE (filename), CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(filename, '[/\\]Batch([0-9]+)[/\\][^/\\]+$', 1) AS INT) AS batchid FROM READ_CSV($prospect_path, delim = ',', header = FALSE, quote = '', escape = '', nullstr = '', filename = TRUE, "columns" = {'agencyid': 'VARCHAR', 'lastname': 'VARCHAR', 'firstname': 'VARCHAR', 'middleinitial': 'VARCHAR', 'gender': 'VARCHAR', 'addressline1': 'VARCHAR', 'addressline2': 'VARCHAR', 'postalcode': 'VARCHAR', 'city': 'VARCHAR', 'state': 'VARCHAR', 'country': 'VARCHAR', 'phone': 'VARCHAR', 'income': 'BIGINT', 'numbercars': 'SMALLINT', 'numberchildren': 'SMALLINT', 'maritalstatus': 'VARCHAR', 'age': 'SMALLINT', 'creditrating': 'SMALLINT', 'ownorrentflag': 'VARCHAR', 'employer': 'VARCHAR', 'numbercreditcards': 'SMALLINT', 'networth': 'BIGINT'})), tagged AS (SELECT *, CONCAT(CASE WHEN networth > 1000000 OR income > 200000 THEN 'HighValue+' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN numberchildren > 3 OR numbercreditcards > 5 THEN 'Expenses+' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN age > 45 THEN 'Boomer+' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN income < 50000 OR creditrating < 600 OR networth < 100000 THEN 'MoneyAlert+' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN numbercars > 3 OR numbercreditcards > 7 THEN 'Spender+' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN age < 25 AND networth > 1000000 THEN 'Inherited+' ELSE '' END) AS tags FROM prospect) SELECT * EXCLUDE (tags), NULLIF(RTRIM(tags, '+'), '') AS marketingnameplate FROM tagged

INSERT INTO DImessages (MessageDateAndTime, BatchID, MessageSource, MessageText, MessageType, MessageData) SELECT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 1, 'DimCompany', 'Invalid SPRating', 'Alert', CONCAT('CO_ID = ', TRIM(SUBSTRING(value, 61, 10)), ', CO_SP_RATE = ', TRIM(SUBSTRING(value, 77, 4))) FROM FinWire WHERE rectype = 'CMP' AND NOT TRIM(SUBSTRING(value, 77, 4)) IN ('AAA', 'AA+', 'AA', 'AA-', 'A+', 'A', 'A-', 'BBB+', 'BBB', 'BBB-', 'BB+', 'BB', 'BB-', 'B+', 'B', 'B-', 'CCC+', 'CCC', 'CCC-', 'CC', 'C', 'D');
INSERT INTO DimCompany (SK_CompanyID, CompanyID, Status, Name, Industry, SPrating, isLowGrade, CEO, AddressLine1, AddressLine2, PostalCode, City, StateProv, Country, Description, FoundingDate, IsCurrent, BatchID, EffectiveDate, EndDate) WITH cmp AS (SELECT recdate AS effectivedate, rects, value AS record, TRIM(SUBSTRING(value, 1, 60)) AS name, CAST(TRIM(SUBSTRING(value, 61, 10)) AS BIGINT) AS companyid, TRIM(SUBSTRING(value, 71, 4)) AS status, TRIM(SUBSTRING(value, 75, 2)) AS industryid, TRIM(SUBSTRING(value, 77, 4)) AS sprating, NULLIF(TRIM(SUBSTRING(value, 81, 8)), '') AS foundingdate, TRIM(SUBSTRING(value, 89, 80)) AS addressline1, TRIM(SUBSTRING(value, 169, 80)) AS addressline2, TRIM(SUBSTRING(value, 249, 12)) AS postalcode, TRIM(SUBSTRING(value, 261, 25)) AS city, TRIM(SUBSTRING(value, 286, 20)) AS stateprov, TRIM(SUBSTRING(value, 306, 24)) AS country, TRIM(SUBSTRING(value, 330, 46)) AS ceo, TRIM(SUBSTRING(value, 376, 150)) AS description FROM FinWire WHERE rectype = 'CMP'), rated AS (SELECT *, sprating IN ('AAA', 'AA+', 'AA', 'AA-', 'A+', 'A', 'A-', 'BBB+', 'BBB', 'BBB-', 'BB+', 'BB', 'BB-', 'B+', 'B', 'B-', 'CCC+', 'CCC', 'CCC-', 'CC', 'C', 'D') AS valid_rating, COALESCE(LEAD(effectivedate) OVER (PARTITION BY companyid ORDER BY rects, record), CAST('9999-12-31' AS DATE)) AS enddate FROM cmp) SELECT CAST(STRFTIME(r.effectivedate, '%Y%m%d') || CAST(r.companyid AS TEXT) AS BIGINT), r.companyid, st.ST_NAME, r.name, ind.IN_NAME, CASE WHEN r.valid_rating THEN r.sprating END, CASE WHEN r.valid_rating THEN NOT (r.sprating LIKE 'A%' OR r.sprating LIKE 'BBB%') END, r.ceo, r.addressline1, r.addressline2, r.postalcode, r.city, r.stateprov, r.country, r.description, CAST(STRPTIME(r.foundingdate, '%Y%m%d') AS DATE), r.enddate = CAST('9999-12-31' AS DATE), 1, r.effectivedate, r.enddate FROM rated AS r JOIN StatusType AS st ON st.ST_ID = r.status JOIN Industry AS ind ON ind.IN_ID = r.industryid WHERE r.effectivedate < r.enddate
tpcdi-etl:duckdb:historical:dim_security: INSERT INTO DimSecurity (SK_SecurityID, Symbol, Issue, Status, Name, ExchangeID, SK_CompanyID, SharesOutstanding, FirstTrade, FirstTradeOnExchange, Dividend, IsCurrent, BatchID, EffectiveDate, EndDate) WITH sec AS (SELECT recdate AS effectivedate, rects, value AS record, TRIM(SUBSTRING(value, 1, 15)) AS symbol, TRIM(SUBSTRING(value, 16, 6)) AS issue, TRIM(SUBSTRING(value, 22, 4)) AS status, TRIM(SUBSTRING(value, 26, 70)) AS name, TRIM(SUBSTRING(value, 96, 6)) AS exchangeid, CAST(TRIM(SUBSTRING(value, 102, 13)) AS BIGINT) AS sharesoutstanding, CAST(STRPTIME(SUBSTRING(value, 115, 8), '%Y%m%d') AS DATE) AS firsttrade, CAST(STRPTIME(SUBSTRING(value, 123, 8), '%Y%m%d') AS DATE) AS firsttradeonexchange, CAST(TRIM(SUBSTRING(value, 131, 12)) AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) AS dividend, TRIM(SUBSTRING(value, 143, 60)) AS conameorcik FROM FinWire WHERE rectype = 'SEC'), sec_dated AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(conameorcik AS BIGINT) IS NULL THEN 'NAME' ELSE 'CIK' END AS company_key_kind, CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(conameorcik AS BIGINT) IS NULL THEN conameorcik ELSE CAST(TRY_CAST(conameorcik AS BIGINT) AS TEXT) END AS company_key, COALESCE(LEAD(effectivedate) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY rects, record), CAST('9999-12-31' AS DATE)) AS enddate FROM sec), company_keys AS (SELECT SK_CompanyID, 'CIK' AS company_key_kind, CAST(CompanyID AS TEXT) AS company_key, EffectiveDate, EndDate FROM DimCompany UNION ALL SELECT SK_CompanyID, 'NAME' AS company_key_kind, Name AS company_key, EffectiveDate, EndDate FROM DimCompany), split AS (SELECT s.symbol, s.issue, st.ST_NAME AS status, s.name, s.exchangeid, c.SK_CompanyID AS sk_companyid, s.sharesoutstanding, s.firsttrade, s.firsttradeonexchange, s.dividend, GREATEST(s.effectivedate, c.EffectiveDate) AS effectivedate, LEAST(s.enddate, c.EndDate) AS enddate FROM sec_dated AS s JOIN company_keys AS c ON c.company_key_kind = s.company_key_kind AND c.company_key = s.company_key AND c.EffectiveDate < s.enddate AND c.EndDate > s.effectivedate JOIN StatusType AS st ON st.ST_ID = s.status WHERE s.effectivedate < s.enddate) SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY effectivedate, symbol), symbol, issue, status, name, exchangeid, sk_companyid, sharesoutstanding, firsttrade, firsttradeonexchange, dividend, enddate = CAST('9999-12-31' AS DATE), 1, effectivedate, enddate FROM split WHERE effectivedate < enddate
tpcdi-etl:duckdb:historical:financial: INSERT INTO Financial (SK_CompanyID, FI_YEAR, FI_QTR, FI_QTR_START_DATE, FI_REVENUE, FI_NET_EARN, FI_BASIC_EPS, FI_DILUT_EPS, FI_MARGIN, FI_INVENTORY, FI_ASSETS, FI_LIABILITY, FI_OUT_BASIC, FI_OUT_DILUT) WITH fin AS (SELECT recdate, CAST(SUBSTRING(value, 1, 4) AS SMALLINT) AS fi_year, CAST(SUBSTRING(value, 5, 1) AS SMALLINT) AS fi_qtr, CAST(STRPTIME(SUBSTRING(value, 6, 8), '%Y%m%d') AS DATE) AS fi_qtr_start_date, CAST(TRIM(SUBSTRING(value, 22, 17)) AS DECIMAL(15, 2)) AS fi_revenue, CAST(TRIM(SUBSTRING(value, 39, 17)) AS DECIMAL(15, 2)) AS fi_net_earn, CAST(TRIM(SUBSTRING(value, 56, 12)) AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) AS fi_basic_eps, CAST(TRIM(SUBSTRING(value, 68, 12)) AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) AS fi_dilut_eps, CAST(TRIM(SUBSTRING(value, 80, 12)) AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) AS fi_margin, CAST(TRIM(SUBSTRING(value, 92, 17)) AS DECIMAL(15, 2)) AS fi_inventory, CAST(TRIM(SUBSTRING(value, 109, 17)) AS DECIMAL(15, 2)) AS fi_assets, CAST(TRIM(SUBSTRING(value, 126, 17)) AS DECIMAL(15, 2)) AS fi_liability, CAST(TRIM(SUBSTRING(value, 143, 13)) AS BIGINT) AS fi_out_basic, CAST(TRIM(SUBSTRING(value, 156, 13)) AS BIGINT) AS fi_out_dilut, TRIM(SUBSTRING(value, 169, 60)) AS conameorcik FROM FinWire WHERE rectype = 'FIN'), fin_keyed AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(conameorcik AS BIGINT) IS NULL THEN 'NAME' ELSE 'CIK' END AS company_key_kind, CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(conameorcik AS BIGINT) IS NULL THEN conameorcik ELSE CAST(TRY_CAST(conameorcik AS BIGINT) AS TEXT) END AS company_key FROM fin), company_keys AS (SELECT SK_CompanyID, 'CIK' AS company_key_kind, CAST(CompanyID AS TEXT) AS company_key, EffectiveDate, EndDate FROM DimCompany UNION ALL SELECT SK_CompanyID, 'NAME' AS company_key_kind, Name AS company_key, EffectiveDate, EndDate FROM DimCompany) SELECT c.SK_CompanyID, f.fi_year, f.fi_qtr, f.fi_qtr_start_date, f.fi_revenue, f.fi_net_earn, f.fi_basic_eps, f.fi_dilut_eps, f.fi_margin, f.fi_inventory, f.fi_assets, f.fi_liability, f.fi_out_basic, f.fi_out_dilut FROM fin_keyed AS f JOIN company_keys AS c ON c.company_key_kind = f.company_key_kind AND c.company_key = f.company_key AND f.recdate >= c.EffectiveDate AND f.recdate < c.EndDate
tpcdi-etl:duckdb:historical:dim_account: INSERT INTO DimAccount (SK_AccountID, AccountID, SK_BrokerID, SK_CustomerID, Status, AccountDesc, TaxStatus, IsCurrent, BatchID, EffectiveDate, EndDate) WITH account AS (SELECT accountid, customerid, CASE WHEN actiontype = 'CLOSEACCT' THEN 'INAC' ELSE 'ACTV' END AS status_id, LAST_VALUE(accountdesc IGNORE NULLS) OVER w AS accountdesc, LAST_VALUE(taxstatus IGNORE NULLS) OVER w AS taxstatus, LAST_VALUE(brokerid IGNORE NULLS) OVER w AS brokerid, CAST(update_ts AS DATE) AS effectivedate, COALESCE(LEAD(CAST(update_ts AS DATE)) OVER (PARTITION BY accountid ORDER BY update_ts), CAST('9999-12-31' AS DATE)) AS enddate FROM CustomerMgmtRaw WHERE actiontype IN ('NEW', 'ADDACCT', 'UPDACCT', 'CLOSEACCT') WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY accountid ORDER BY update_ts ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)), split AS (SELECT a.accountid, a.brokerid, c.SK_CustomerID AS sk_customerid, CASE WHEN c.Status = inactive.ST_NAME THEN inactive.ST_ID ELSE a.status_id END AS status_id, a.accountdesc, a.taxstatus, GREATEST(a.effectivedate, c.EffectiveDate) AS effectivedate, LEAST(a.enddate, c.EndDate) AS enddate FROM account AS a JOIN DimCustomer AS c ON c.CustomerID = a.customerid AND c.EffectiveDate < a.enddate AND c.EndDate > a.effectivedate JOIN StatusType AS inactive ON inactive.ST_ID = 'INAC' WHERE a.effectivedate < a.enddate) SELECT CAST(STRFTIME(s.effectivedate, '%Y%m%d') || CAST(s.accountid AS TEXT) AS BIGINT), s.accountid, b.SK_BrokerID, s.sk_customerid, st.ST_NAME, s.accountdesc, s.taxstatus, s.enddate = CAST('9999-12-31' AS DATE), 1, s.effectivedate, s.enddate FROM split AS s JOIN DimBroker AS b ON b.BrokerID = s.brokerid JOIN StatusType AS st ON st.ST_ID = s.status_id WHERE s.effectivedate < s.enddate

INSERT INTO Prospect (AgencyID, SK_RecordDateID, SK_UpdateDateID, BatchID, IsCustomer, LastName, FirstName, MiddleInitial, Gender, AddressLine1, AddressLine2, PostalCode, City, State, Country, Phone, Income, NumberCars, NumberChildren, MaritalStatus, Age, CreditRating, OwnOrRentFlag, Employer, NumberCreditCards, NetWorth, MarketingNameplate) WITH current_customers AS (SELECT DISTINCT UPPER(c.LastName) AS lastname, UPPER(c.FirstName) AS firstname, UPPER(c.AddressLine1) AS addressline1, UPPER(COALESCE(c.AddressLine2, '')) AS addressline2, UPPER(c.PostalCode) AS postalcode FROM DimCustomer AS c JOIN StatusType AS st ON st.ST_ID = 'ACTV' AND st.ST_NAME = c.Status WHERE c.IsCurrent) SELECT p.agencyid, d.SK_DateID, d.SK_DateID, 1, NOT c.lastname IS NULL, p.lastname, p.firstname, p.middleinitial, p.gender, p.addressline1, p.addressline2, p.postalcode, p.city, p.state, p.country, p.phone, p.income, p.numbercars, p.numberchildren, p.maritalstatus, p.age, p.creditrating, p.ownorrentflag, p.employer, p.numbercreditcards, p.networth, p.marketingnameplate FROM ProspectRaw AS p JOIN BatchDate AS b ON b.batchid = p.batchid JOIN DimDate AS d ON d.DateValue = b.batchdate LEFT JOIN current_customers AS c ON c.lastname = UPPER(p.lastname) AND c.firstname = UPPER(p.firstname) AND c.addressline1 = UPPER(p.addressline1) AND c.addressline2 = UPPER(COALESCE(p.addressline2, '')) AND c.postalcode = UPPER(p.postalcode) WHERE p.batchid = 1;
INSERT INTO DImessages (MessageDateAndTime, BatchID, MessageSource, MessageText, MessageType, MessageData) SELECT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 1, 'Prospect', 'Inserted rows', 'Status', CAST(COUNT(*) AS TEXT) FROM Prospect WHERE BatchID = 1
tpcdi-etl:duckdb:historical:fact_cash_ba: INSERT INTO FactCashBalances (SK_CustomerID, SK_AccountID, SK_DateID, Cash, BatchID) WITH daily AS (SELECT accountid, CAST(ct_dts AS DATE) AS datevalue, SUM(ct_amt) AS amount FROM CashTransactionRaw WHERE batchid = 1 GROUP BY accountid, CAST(ct_dts AS DATE)), balances AS (SELECT accountid, datevalue, SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY accountid ORDER BY datevalue) AS cash FROM daily) SELECT a.SK_CustomerID, a.SK_AccountID, d.SK_DateID, b.cash, 1 FROM balances AS b JOIN DimDate AS d ON d.DateValue = b.datevalue JOIN DimAccount AS a ON a.AccountID = b.accountid AND b.datevalue >= a.EffectiveDate AND b.datevalue < a.EndDate
tpcdi-etl:duckdb:historical:fact_holding: INSERT INTO FactHoldings (TradeID, CurrentTradeID, SK_CustomerID, SK_AccountID, SK_SecurityID, SK_CompanyID, SK_DateID, SK_TimeID, CurrentPrice, CurrentHolding, BatchID) SELECT h.hh_h_t_id, h.hh_t_id, t.SK_CustomerID, t.SK_AccountID, t.SK_SecurityID, t.SK_CompanyID, t.SK_CloseDateID, t.SK_CloseTimeID, t.TradePrice, h.hh_after_qty, 1 FROM HoldingHistoryRaw AS h JOIN DimTrade AS t ON t.TradeID = h.hh_t_id WHERE h.batchid = 1
tpcdi-etl:duckdb:historical:fact_watches: INSERT INTO FactWatches (SK_CustomerID, SK_SecurityID, SK_DateID_DatePlaced, SK_DateID_DateRemoved, BatchID) WITH watches AS (SELECT w_c_id AS customerid, w_s_symb AS symbol, CAST(MIN(CASE WHEN w_action = 'ACTV' THEN w_dts END) AS DATE) AS dateplaced, CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN w_action = 'CNCL' THEN w_dts END) AS DATE) AS dateremoved FROM WatchHistoryRaw WHERE batchid = 1 GROUP BY w_c_id, w_s_symb) SELECT c.SK_CustomerID, s.SK_SecurityID, placed.SK_DateID, removed.SK_DateID, 1 FROM watches AS w JOIN DimDate AS placed ON placed.DateValue = w.dateplaced LEFT JOIN DimDate AS removed ON removed.DateValue = w.dateremoved JOIN DimSecurity AS s ON s.Symbol = w.symbol AND w.dateplaced >= s.EffectiveDate AND w.dateplaced < s.EndDate JOIN DimCustomer AS c ON c.CustomerID = w.customerid AND w.dateplaced >= c.EffectiveDate AND w.dateplaced < c.EndDate

tpcdi-etl:duckdb:incremental:fact_cash_b: INSERT INTO FactCashBalances (SK_CustomerID, SK_AccountID, SK_DateID, Cash, BatchID) WITH daily AS (SELECT accountid, SUM(ct_amt) AS amount FROM CashTransactionRaw WHERE batchid = $batch_id GROUP BY accountid), prior AS (SELECT a.AccountID AS accountid, ARG_MAX(f.Cash, f.SK_DateID) AS cash FROM FactCashBalances AS f JOIN DimAccount AS a ON a.SK_AccountID = f.SK_AccountID WHERE a.AccountID IN (SELECT accountid FROM daily) GROUP BY a.AccountID) SELECT cur.SK_CustomerID, cur.SK_AccountID, d.SK_DateID, COALESCE(p.cash, 0) + daily.amount, $batch_id FROM daily JOIN DimAccount AS cur ON cur.AccountID = daily.accountid AND cur.IsCurrent JOIN BatchDate AS b ON b.batchid = $batch_id JOIN DimDate AS d ON d.DateValue = b.batchdate LEFT JOIN prior AS p ON p.accountid = daily.accountid
